scene: Clutching your new alien comic, you reach the canal transit hub.
picture: Pixel-art flat side view along a stone promenade. On the far left, a red paddle steamer bobs by a wooden dock. Left of centre, the boy with dark hair and red sneakers stands holding an alien comic and his skateboard. In the centre sits a yellow mini shuttle bus. On the far right hangs a rope-bridge lift cage.
